snippet.description:

snippet.title: [양수쌤 놀이체육] '후프 킥 원마커 득템!'
snippet.description:
체육과 기본 움직임 중 조작 운동 중 '차기'에 관련된 수업인 후프를 활용한 수업을 할때 활용해 보면 좋을 '후프 킥 원마커 득템'입니다. 앞쪽에 원마커를 20~30장 깔아 뒤죽박죽 놓고 팀별로 1명씩 후프를 발로 차서 후프가 원마커에 닿거나 후프 안쪽으로 들어가면 원마커를 획득해 가져옵니다. 게임 후 가장 많은 원마커를 획득한 팀 순으로 순위를 가려 칭찬해 주면 됩니다. 게임의 난이도를 높이려면 후프 안에 원마커가 완전히 들어갔을 때에만 획득하는 방법으로 바꿔도 되겠습니다.
 또 하나 아이디어를 드리면 운동 그림이 표기된 무빙원마커만 깔아두고 후프를 차 득템하면 원마커의 운동의 횟수를 팀 전원이 함께 원마커에 따라 실시하는 방법으로 하면 더 많은 운동 효과도 내면서 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

en-US.title: [Yangsu Teacher's Play Physical Education] Kinball Low Ball Control Tips!
en-US.description: In kin-ball, there are many instances where you need to receive a low ball. Most players slide, but school physical education classes often don't teach this skill because not all players have knee pads. A low ball can be floated by simply extending your foot and landing on the ground. Instead of this method, stepping forward under the ball when it's low will allow you to control it without dropping it. When teaching kin-ball, it's helpful to thoroughly teach both the principles and the techniques.

en-US.title: [Yangsu Teacher's Playful Physical Education] Exciting Tag Game - "Take It, Tag 1"
en-US.description:
This is a fun game of tag using a ball or beanbag. Two people face each other, standing 2-3 meters apart, and toss the ball back and forth. When a whistle blows, the player holding the ball or beanbag becomes the tagger and chases the other players while they run away. When the whistle blows again, the player holding the ball or beanbag throws or tags the ball back and forth. Then, when the whistle blows again, the player holding the ball or beanbag becomes the tagger again! It's perfect as a warm-up for classes using balls or bean bags.

en-US.title: [Yangsu Teacher's Playful Sports] 'Plank Volleyball': Fun and Physical!
en-US.description:
I tried a game of volleyball with balloons, lying face down and building endurance. It seems like it's only for older elementary school students. It's a one-on-one game where you have to knock over your opponent's balloon within three hits. Even though it's a short game played face down, it's incredibly effective. It would be possible to set up multiple game areas and play simultaneously, with a five-point game, and it could even be implemented in classroom physical education classes. In the classroom, try placing a long fun stick between two chairs and giving it a try. Teacher Yang's Useful Tools

en-US.title: [Yangsu Teacher's Playful Physical Education] 'Get the Hoop Kick One Marker!'
en-US.description:
This "Hoop Kick Circle Marker" is a great way to teach hoop-based basic movement exercises, especially those involving "kicking." Lay out 20-30 circle markers in front of you, then have one player from each team kick a hoop. Each time the hoop touches or enters a circle marker, the player collects the circle marker. After the game, you can rank the teams with the most circle markers and praise them. To increase the difficulty, you can change the game so that the marker is only awarded when it's completely inside the hoop.
Another idea: place moving circle markers with exercise pictures on them. When the player kicks the hoop, the whole team counts the number of circle markers. This way, you can maximize the exercise and enjoy the game. *Teaching Materials Used by Teacher Yang

en-US.description:
This is a one-on-one game called "High-Air, Low-Air Dodgeball." Divided into two teams, each team sends one player to the field. Since the thrower has the advantage, it's best to carefully manage the distance between the fleeing player and the safe zone, ensuring they're not out if they're hit by the ball.
If the fleeing player dodges the ball and enters the safe zone, the team earns one point. If they hit the ball first, the team that hit them earns one point. One team then throws the ball to the target, and the teams switch roles and repeat the game. The team with the highest score at the end of the game wins! *Used Teaching Aids

en-US.description: If you tie a string to a volleyball after inflating it, the string will become loose and the air inside the ball will gradually escape. After inflating the volleyball liner to its fullest, hold the end of the liner's inlet and turn it in one direction about 10 times, then push the end of the liner inlet between the outer and inner liner with your finger. You're done! You can inflate and dispose of the inlet in this way for volleyballs, balloon balls, and kinballs.
